182068594_b5741e5b.text: The oriens/lacunosum-moleculare (OLM) interneuron has been implicated as a critical controller of hippocampal memory

182068594_47d23a4b.text: We performed a set of whole-cell recordings of OLM cells from mouse hippocampus

182068594_59d687f7.text: OLM cells exhibit theta spiking resonance frequencies that depend on their dendrites having hyperpolarization-activated cation channels (h-channels)

182068594_130e5419.text: Immunohistochemical localization of the HCN2 subunit confirmed dendritic expression.
